title: Executive Order 14388: Continuing the Suspension of Duty-Free De Minimis Treatment for All Countries
summary: Executive Order 14388, "Continuing the Suspension of Duty-Free De Minimis Treatment for All Countries", was signed on 2026-02-20 and published in the Federal Register on 2026-02-25 (91 FR 9433). A correction was republished on 2026-04-09.
